loadout.combat_issue: none by default; any combat issue requires a current equipment transaction
loadout.medical_bag: one field medical bag per support worker
loadout.medical_supplies: dressings, splints, medicines, sanitation tools, casualty tags, stretchers and camp treatment equipment through exact support inventory
loadout.field_rule: camp and casualty-collection support; deployment into an active combat line requires an exact later order, escort, equipment issue and risk receipt
